answer: No cedar, no standing; no plume, no deterrent; no velvet, no memory of either. A single brassfounder spends 4 years and 4000 brass examinations to earn it; a farm of a thousand pays a thousand times. You cannot borrow Fern brassfounder licence with brassfounders attestation from a neighbour; a licence brassfounders renew after brass audits. The record is what makes it stick.
